title: Quasium
description: Quasium Server. A server based on Create mods. Gamestyle: Survival
body:
Quasium Minecraft is a survival multiplayer Minecraft server project based on a custom modpack built around the **Create** mod. The server runs on Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge and is designed to provide a technical survival experience focused on automation, building, resource progression, engineering systems, and cooperative gameplay.

The purpose of the project is to host and maintain a fair, community-oriented Minecraft environment where players can develop bases, build mechanical systems, create factories, trade resources, and participate in shared progression. The server uses mods to expand vanilla survival gameplay while keeping the core focus on exploration, creativity, and long-term world development.

Quasium does not aim to provide pay-to-win advantages. The project is moderated through clear community rules, including restrictions against griefing, cheating, exploiting bugs, harassment, and toxic behavior. Player support, reports, updates, rules, and modpack information are handled through the official Discord server: discord.comradixk.cc.
